entries.meaning: The control layer that routes bounded work to registered workers, retains state and exposes outcomes.
A layered representation of utterance, tokens, intent, sources, computation, policy and receipts.
On-demand routing from a human request to the relevant case context and supported operation.
A versioned case-scoped snapshot of source identities, indexes, topology, tasks, worker/provider roles and lens projections.
A reproducible file projection of a capsule; not a second authoritative database.
A bounded execution role; the Go worker is a stateless process, not a model or autonomous persona.
An adapter role exposing measured tools and limits of a provider; this build has local Python and Go providers.
A projection of implemented architecture, state/effect constraints and worker boundaries.
A projection of actual receipt checks and source-bound test outcomes; not an independent semantic reviewer.
Source-bound lexical postings plus explicitly defined meanings; model embeddings and calibrated semantic confidence are absent.
The supported operation selected for a request: context, exact money addition, or explicit-reference topology.
A responsibility boundary: ingestion, language/math/topology computation, durable control, or human review.
